name: St John the Evangelist, Bromley Cross

boundary.description: From the point where Broadhead Road crosses Twitchels Brook, S along Blackburn – Rossendale District boundary, Blackburn - Bury District boundary and Blackburn – Bolton District boundary to and S along the middle of the Jumbles Reservoir. Then S along Bradshaw Brook to its crossing with Printers Lane, and W along Printers Lane, N and then W along Turton Road, then across Birtenshaw School and by a footpath to Eagley Brook. N by Eagly Brook, Dewhurst Clough, Delph Brook and by Blackburn – Bolton District boundary to Blackburn Road (A666). N by Blackburn Road to Cadshaw Brook and along northern boundary of North Turton civil parish to the crossing of Broadhead Road and Twitchels Brook.
